regions.merged_text: God bless you Miss Grace L. Panyard. God bless you and yours these unsettled days - in a way, fearfully threatening days and full of uncanny forebodings; viz, in asmuch as the individual or the whole world has been and seems actually to be turning away from God, to seek peace elsewhere than in His privileged service; in just so much do we find - individually or Humanity as a whole - unrest, disapointment, discouragement. God bless you MI, ..
